title: Power BI Desktop Handbook Manifest
description: Defines a report-construction handbook for a specific Power BI Desktop release. The manifest drives validation, HTML generation, and semantic model contract extraction.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for IDE autocomplete.

id.description: A unique, URL-safe identifier for this handbook (e.g., 'operations-pulse').

title.description: Display title for the handbook (e.g., 'Operations Pulse').

organization.description: Organization name displayed in the handbook header.

subtitle.description: A brief description displayed below the title.

release.description: Target Power BI Desktop build number (e.g., '2.150.5353.0').

page.description: Report page dimensions and optional background color.

background.description: Hex color for the page background.

brand.description: Brand colors applied to report content inside the handbook.

accent.description: Accent color for the report header and brand elements.

secondary.description: Secondary color for metadata and decorative elements.

snapshot.description: Headline metrics displayed on the overview page.

visuals.description: Ordered list of visuals to place on the report page.

sections.description: Ordered build-workflow steps displayed as checklists.

acceptance.description: Final acceptance criteria displayed as a checklist.

id.description: Unique visual identifier within this manifest (e.g., 'open-incidents').

title.description: Visual title displayed in the handbook.

type.description: Visual type — a gallery label (e.g., 'Matrix'), alias (e.g., 'current card'), or internal schema identifier (e.g., 'pivotTable').

fields.description: Field assignments. Accepts legacy strings (e.g., 'Y-axis: Team[Name]') and structured objects.

oneOf.description: Legacy field string. Optionally prefixed with a role label and colon.

settings.description: Format-pane settings to apply to this visual.

notes.description: Free-text notes displayed below the visual card.

Position.description: Visual placement within the report page, in pixels.

StructuredField.description: A structured field assignment with explicit role, kind, and aggregation metadata.

role.description: Build-role ID (e.g., 'yAxis') or displayed label (e.g., 'Y-axis'). Matched case- and punctuation-insensitively.

kind.description: Field kind. Defaults to 'unknown' if omitted.

aggregation.description: Aggregation function (e.g., 'Sum', 'Average'), or null for default/none.

Setting.description: A format-pane instruction for this visual.

path.description: Format pane navigation path (e.g., 'Format visual > Bars').

label.description: Setting label within the format card (e.g., 'Color').

value.description: Setting value — typically a string, number, or boolean.

schemaObject.description: Schema object name for validation (e.g., 'bars'). Must be paired with schemaProperty.

schemaProperty.description: Schema property name for validation (e.g., 'barColor'). Must be paired with schemaObject.
